parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *halli (compare Estonian hall), from Balto-Slavic; compare Latvian salnis, Lithuanian šalnis (“off-white, roan”).

parole.significato: to gnaw, eat away, wear (to destroy gradually as by taking tiny little bites)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *jäütädäk, derived from a borrowing from early Balto-Slavic.

parole.significato: grain, cereal, corn (type of grass cultivated for its edible grains)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *vilja (compare Estonian vili, Karelian vil'l'a, Veps vilʹlʹ), borrowed from Balto-Slavic or Baltic (compare Proto-Slavic *obilъ, whence Russian обилие (obilije, “abundance”) and Czech obilí (“grain”)); see the Proto-Finnic entry for more.
